info.name: OSCAR EMR 19 - SOAP Services (All 14)
info.description: Full catalog of this OSCAR install's legacy SOAP layer (WS-Security UsernameToken), discovered via https://<host>:8443/oscar/ws/?wsdl. Auth is username/password (LoginService.login2), not client id/token (OAuth1) like the REST collection. Run '01. LoginService > Login (login2)' once - its test script auto-fills soapSecurityId/soapSecurityTokenKey, which every other request embeds in a wsse:UsernameToken header directly in the raw XML body (Postman has no native WS-Security auth type). See docs/oscar/new-approach/oscar-soap-schedule-services.md for verified samples and background. Requests marked WRITE actually change data in OSCAR - do not run without the project owner's explicit go-ahead. Many operations were never live-tested; argN names reflect the WSDL exactly (no javadoc names available) - edit placeholder values before running.

request.description: Clears the captured securityId/securityTokenKey while preserving environment variable definitions.
